Job Description
A global leader in advanced robotics and automation is seeking a  Machine Learning Engineer, Physical AI Systems  to join its robotics engineering organization in  Westborough, Massachusetts . 
This role focuses on developing machine learning systems that enable autonomous robots to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world. You will build and deploy AI models that help robotic platforms identify products, determine optimal grasp points, manipulate objects, and transport inventory safely and efficiently throughout highly automated fulfillment environments. 
Working at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and large-scale automation, you will collaborate with software engineers, roboticists, and hardware teams to solve real-world challenges involving robotic picking, package handling, object recognition, and autonomous movement. Your work will directly impact the performance of robotic systems responsible for moving millions of items through complex operational environments. 
This is a full-time employee (FTE) position based in  Westborough, MA , with regular onsite collaboration in robotics development labs and testing facilities. Required Skills & Experience    3+ years of industry experience in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Vision, or a related technical field  Strong programming experience in Python  Experience developing and deploying machine learning models into production environments  Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow  Strong understanding of computer vision, object detection, segmentation, and perception systems  Experience working with large-scale datasets and training pipelines  Familiarity with Linux development environments  Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including testing, Git, code reviews, and CI/CD  Ability to work closely with both software and hardware engineering teams  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience with robotics platforms and autonomous systems  Knowledge of ROS or ROS 2  Experience with robotic manipulation, grasp planning, or motion planning  Familiarity with RGB, depth camera, stereo vision, LiDAR, or multimodal sensor systems  Experience deploying machine learning models onto edge devices or robotic hardware  Exposure to reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or behavior modeling  Familiarity with simulation environments such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or related robotics tools  Master's degree or Ph.D. in a related field
  What You Will Be Doing
 Daily Responsibilities     Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that enable robots to identify, locate, and manipulate physical objects  Develop computer vision systems that help robots distinguish boxes, totes, packages, and inventory items under varying environmental conditions  Build perception models that determine how robotic arms should approach, grasp, lift, and move objects of different sizes, shapes, and weights  Partner with robotics software engineers to integrate machine learning models into production robotic systems  Analyze real-world robot performance data to improve picking accuracy, handling efficiency, and system reliability  Develop training and evaluation pipelines using data collected from deployed robotic platforms  Optimize machine learning models for low-latency inference on physical robotic hardware  Design experiments to improve robotic manipulation success rates across challenging operational scenarios  Validate model performance through lab testing, simulation, and real-world robotic deployments  Contribute to the development of next-generation Physical AI systems that combine perception, decision-making, and robotic control
  The Offer    Full-time employee (FTE) opportunity based in Westborough, MA   Competitive base salary:  $140,000 - $170,000   Annual performance bonus eligibility  Employee stock purchase program and equity opportunities  Career advancement within a world-class robotics and machine learning organization  Opportunity to develop cutting-edge Physical AI technologies deployed at massive scale  Collaborative environment focused on innovation, experimentation, and technical excellence
 
You will receive the following benefits    Medical Insurance  Dental Benefits  Vision Benefits  Paid Time Off (PTO)  401(k) with company match  Employee Stock Purchase Program  Paid Parental Leave  Life and Disability Insurance  Professional Development Resources
 
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis now and in the future.

**About The Role**
As a Software Engineer III, you'll take full ownership of key software subsystems, driving their development and support through the entire lifecycle. You'll serve as a subject matter expert in multiple areas, bringing innovative solutions and leading technical discussions to enhance quality and operational processes. If you thrive in leadership roles with minimal supervision, and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this role offers the opportunity to make a lasting impact on both your team and the product.
  
  
**Your Area of Focus**

* Own software subsystem through full development and support lifecycle.
* Bring creative and innovative software solutions to the team.
* Subject Matter Expert in 2+ area of the software.
* Sounding board for technical discussions.
* Improve quality and operational processes.
* Triage challenging bugs.

**Your Professional Qualifications**

* 2+ years of software development experience.
* Professional experience developing scalable micro-service based web applications with modern Java and the Spring framework.
* Professional experience developing in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Typescript, and JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, etc).
* Applicable knowledge in computer architecture and design, data access patterns, scalability and resiliency patterns, and object-oriented software techniques.
* Technical Leadership with Minimal Supervision.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to apply them in day-to-day work.
* Use data to make technical recommendations and decisions.
* Key contributor to technical team discussions and engineering debates.
* Ability to accurately estimate scope on larger software projects.
* Looks beyond current execution of tasks.
* Proficient at debugging other engineers code.
* Ability and credibility from team to lead.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Domain experience in healthcare preferred, but not required.

**About Tebra**
Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com.
  
  
**Our Values**
**Start with the Customer**
We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.
  
  
**Keep It Simple**
Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.
